test_forward: test the forward.forward function computes position, velocity, and acceleration state for batched MuJoCo models on GPU
test_step: test the forward.step function advances MuJoCo simulation state over time with WARP and WARP_STAGED graph modes
test_jit_caching: test jit caching on the forward.step function to verify compiled kernels are reused across batched calls
test_step_cpu: test the forward.step function runs on CPU device for batched MuJoCo simulation steps
test_step_leading_dim_mismatch: test that forward.step raises ValueError when batch dimension mismatch occurs in qpos or contact data
